stories.event: Milion chvilek pro demokracii holds the rally 'Letná proti 4:36' on Prague's Letná plain on Sunday 15 November at 14:00 against the government bill that abolishes the ČT and ČRo licence fees and funds both broadcasters from the state budget; the coalition pushed the bill through first reading at 04:36 on 24 October. research.question: Which facts settle the forecaster disagreement on cz-letna-count-16 (organisers' first figure >=300k) and cz-letna-next-16 (dated further action announced at Letná on 15 Nov 2026)?
research.finding: (a) 21 Mar 2026: Minář's first stage figure, after seeing crane footage, was 'Je nás tu minimálně 200 až 250 tisíc' (Novinky live, modified 2026-03-21T17:49Z, https://www.novinky.cz/clanek/domaci-demonstrace-praha-letna-milion-chvilek-online-40569066). Later entries and headlines rounded it to 'čtvrt milionu' / 'až 250 tisíc' (same live; Blesk https://www.blesk.cz/clanek/835685; CNN Prima https://cnn.iprima.cz/on-line-je-nas-tu-az-250-tisic-prohlasil-na-letne-minar-akci-doprovazi-narusitele-507398). ČTK reported 'minimálně 250.000' (https://www.ceskenoviny.cz/zpravy/zive-na-letne-se-kona-shromazdeni-kritizujici-kroky-vlady/2801470). Under the criterion's lower-bound rule the March first figure is 200,000, so March is a NO case either way. Jun 2019: the first figure was ~250,000 at the start (Echo24 https://www.echo24.cz/a/SgZHS/kolik-lidi-prislo-na-letnou-ctvrt-milionu-nebo-daleko-vic-podle-t-mobile-258-000), and 400,000 came only at the end (Deník https://www.denik.cz/cesko/letna-demonstrace-babis-pocet-ucastniku-t-mobile-mapchecking-drony/). So the first figure was 250k, which is a NO on the criterion. Pattern: Minář gives a cautious first range and raises it later. (b) No new numeric target or expected-attendance figure from Minář, the police or DPP was found for 13 Nov. Latest is Novinky 13 Nov (https://www.novinky.cz/clanek/domaci-zpravy-hlavni-mesto-praha-prahu-cekaji-manevry-kvuli-nedelni-demonstraci-na-letne-ktera-vyjde-na-85-milionu-40608331): cost 8m CZK, 'bude to o 10 až 15 procent dražší než akce na jaře, protože bude větší', 'na jednoho účastníka to vychází nižší desítky korun'. That implies Minář plans for roughly 270k–400k at 20–30 CZK a head (my arithmetic, not his number). Novinky gives spring as 'nejméně dvě stě tisíc'. The police Prague assembly page has no entry for 15 Nov (https://policie.gov.cz/hlavni-mesto-praha/shromazdeni-v-praze, last updated 2 Nov). No notified participant number (ohlášení) was found. (c) No dated next action was found beyond the pre-rally statements already in the dossier ('představíme další kroky', 'to Letnou neskončí', spreading to other towns). No hint found of a 17 Nov Milion chvilek event, a strike date or a December date. Analogue: before Nov 2019 Letná, Minář also pre-announced a 'další plán' with 'silnější a kreativnější protestní akce po celé republice' (Echo24 2019-11-12, https://www.echo24.cz/a/SZVvZ/milion-chvilek-ma-dalsi-plan-detaily-predstavi-na-demonstraci-na-letne). The rally then delivered a petition plus an ultimatum, with protests only 'v lednu' (no date). The dated series was announced on 4 Dec. In March 2026 the closing was 'nic nekončí, teprve začínáme' with a conditional June trigger and no date (Novinky live above).

Incumbent José Maria Neves (PAICV), who won outright in 2021 with 51.8%, faces former justice minister Joana Rosa (MpD), the first woman to run, and four independents. stories.event: Pope Leo XIV, the former bishop of Chiclayo, ends his Peru visit with a day in Cusco (meeting at Saqsaywaman, Angelus) and Pucallpa, where on 15 Nov he meets missionaries and Amazonian peoples (Shipibo-Konibo, Asháninka, Kukama) and celebrates the first papal Mass in the Amazon since 1980. Indigenous leaders want him to speak about illegal logging, illegal mining, drug trafficking and killings of forest defenders; in June he raised illegal mining with Peru's president. He flies back to Rome on 16 Nov.

stories.event: Israel's statistics bureau publishes October consumer prices on Sunday evening. Inflation stood at 1.6% in September, below the 1.8% economists expected and in the lower half of the Bank of Israel's 1–3% target; prices fell 0.5% in the month as flights, hotels and fuel got cheaper. stories.event: Germany's gas stores are emptying from the lowest level for the time of year since records began in 2011. They were 57.7% full on 11 November against a five-year average of 88% for the date, after missing the 1 November target, and have been losing about 0.37 percentage points a day. The Federal Network Agency says supply is stable and the danger of a tight situation low, while the storage operators' association INES warns that an extremely cold winter could leave shortfalls in early 2027; Berlin is preparing to keep coal and oil plants on standby.

stories.event: France's fuel shortages are easing but not over. The government's tracker showed 8% of stations nationally short of diesel or of all petrol grades at 9:00 on 13 November, down from 12% on the 11 November holiday; Grand Est stood at 18% and parts of Alsace, Belfort and Paris at 25% or more. The shortages follow the release of 10 million barrels of diesel from strategic stocks from 2 November, which cut prices and lifted sales, while a low Rhine curbed barge deliveries to eastern depots; the river at Kaub has since risen to 68 cm. The government says no further release is on the agenda.

claims.notes: National total rather than a region: it is the headline figure and less noisy. Threshold 9% = the 12 Nov 17h level. Recent official national readings 10, 10, 12 (holiday), 12, 9, 8 (13 Nov 9h): easing as the Rhine recovers (Kaub 68 cm on 13 Nov, forecast ~71–73 cm over the weekend). Against that, a third-party diesel-only series from the same ministry feed (Pleinvoyant) rose from Friday to Sunday in each of the last nine weeks (median ratio ~1.7). Straight easing gives ~6–8%, Friday level plus the usual weekend rise gives ~8–10%: 9% sits near the middle. Alternatives: ≥8% (YES if Friday's level merely holds), ≥10% (needs a full weekend rebound); Grand Est ≥18% (yesterday's claim was on Grand Est; national chosen for variety and reach). Interval claim rejected: no consensus or sourced scale. Main risk is void: Sunday column unconfirmed. The station CSV has no history; resolver must archive the table page. Morning desk: add the 13 Nov 17h and 14 Nov 9h readings to the dossier if published; threshold stays unless they move outside 7–10%. Cause is supply logistics (low Rhine, stock-release demand surge), not strikes; the inter-union strike is on 17 Nov, outside the window.
